title: The Hacktivist Heist
story:
In the bustling city of Silicon Valley, our crime takes place at the prestigious tech startup, 'BitWise.' While working on a new AI assistant prototype, they discovered a massive data breach. The highly sensitive information of their clients, including personal data, financial details, and project plans, had been leaked online.

Crime Scene: The server room of BitWise.
Victim: BitWise IT team.
Crime: Massive Data Leak

Suspect 1: Alice - AI assistant developer
Suspect 2: Bob - cybersecurity analyst
Suspect 3: Charlotte - marketing executive
Suspect 4: Dave - head of IT department

Testimonies:
1. Alice: 'I needed test data for my AI assistant project.'
2. Bob: 'Our fortified network was breached, but I can't say who did it.'
3. Charlotte: 'I had no clue about the server room! I only visit once a week for marketing meetings.'
4. Dave: 'Dave, the head of IT, was the last one to access the server room before the leak.'
forensicClue: An unapproved AI assistant development project.
question: Who is the culprit and how did the detective solve it?
options: Option A (Alice - AI development project and forensic clue)
Option B (Dave - last accessed and forensic clue)
Option C (Bob - network breach and forensic clue)
Option D (Charlotte - meeting schedule and forensic clue)
